reviews.body:
Thanks for the fix, this looks good. Reading `processDataRef.current` in `onmessage` addresses the stale `cpuData` closure, and the test covers it.

One non-blocking suggestion: `isPaused` has the same stale-closure issue. `onmessage` passes the `isPaused` captured when the socket was created, so `processData` always sees `false`. If you can, keeping `isPaused` in a ref the same way (and ideally adding a test for it) would finish the job. A follow-up PR is fine too.

Thanks for the review. I pushed a follow-up commit on this PR for the `isPaused` suggestion: `useWebSocket` now keeps `isPaused` in a ref (same approach as `processData`), so `onmessage` passes the current value to `processData` instead of the one captured when the socket was created. Added a test that re-renders with `isPaused` true and checks `processData` receives `true` without re-creating the connection.

This comment was drafted with the help of an AI assistant (Claude) and the change was tested locally.
